$comment: Verified specification database. Every record was read from the manufacturer product page named in source_url. Records that could not be verified are absent rather than guessed. scripts/validate-data.mjs runs before every build and fails on incomplete or placeholder data.

notes: affiliate_approved stays false until at least one brand program has approved this site. While it is false, no brand affiliate links are rendered.
amazon_tag is independent of affiliate_approved: when set, Amazon search links render on stations that are not out_of_stock or discontinued.
Prices are point-in-time list prices read from the manufacturer page on verified_at. They change often; refresh before relying on them.
A peak figure labelled X-Boost or Power Lifting is a marketing rating for resistive loads, not an inverter surge rating. Those are marked in the record notes.

Records added on 2026-09-30 were read from the manufacturer page in source_url. A model was left out when the shop URL redirected to a different model, or when the only peak figure was a resistive boost with no separate surge number. peak_is_surge false means the stored peak must not be used to clear a motor start.

Records added on 2026-10-05 were read from the manufacturer page in source_url. Models whose US page disagreed with itself on capacity, or whose packshot could not be taken from the same page, were left out.
